name: THE WASHOUT
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE SLIDE
LOOK_AT: Half a hill, lying across the road. The road's still under there, I assume, going to Fiddler's Gulch without me.
Mud, boulders and a whole pine, roots up. It's recent. Nobody has thought to put it back.
I tried climbing it. It moved. I came down a different way than I went up.
LISTEN_TO: Water working through it, a trickle at a time.
Stones ticking down, one every so often.
Quiet, now. It's thinking about the next part.

overrides.PUSH: I shoved it. A stone came down and stopped at my boot, like a reply.
overrides.PICK_UP: One stone at a time, I'd have the road clear by spring. Vessel would have spent everything by then.

subjects.name: THE SIGNPOST
LOOK_AT: A signpost: FIDDLER'S GULCH 3 MI, pointing straight into the slide.
Three miles. I could walk three miles. I can't walk them through a hill.
Somebody has scratched out the 3 and written nothing in its place. Honest, at least.
LISTEN_TO: A loose board knocking in the wind.
The sign creaking a quarter-turn and back. It isn't sure either.
Wind, and a crow further up, laughing at something.

overrides.PULL: It's set deep. Whoever put it up meant it. Then the hill disagreed.
overrides.TALK_TO: I asked it which way now. It pointed into the slide again. It's committed.

subjects.name: THE ROAD BACK
LOOK_AT: The road back to Consolation. Two days of it, and most of it held.
Somewhere down there is my claim, with a raccoon in it, keeping my place.
I'm not going back without Vessel. I've told the road, and it took it well.
LISTEN_TO: Wind coming up it from the valley.
Far off, a wagon. Going the other way, sensibly.
Empty road. It's waiting for somebody with better luck.

overrides.TALK_TO: I told the road I'd be back. Roads hear that from everybody, and believe nobody.

subjects.name: GRIEVANCE
LOOK_AT: Grievance, standing where the road stopped. To be fair, she stopped first.
She's found the one patch of grass on the slide and is treating it as the point of the trip.
She looked at the mine, then at me, then at the grass. One of us is going in.
LISTEN_TO: A long breath through the nose, aimed at the slide.
Chewing. She'll be here. She's made that very clear.

overrides.PUSH: I pushed her, gently, to see if she'd come. She moved one hoof, onto better grass.

subjects.name: THE OLD MINE
LOOK_AT: An old mine in the ridge, propped with timbers. It goes into the hill the road can't get round.
Somebody dug this looking for gold, and found the other side of the hill instead.
Rails come out of it and stop at the edge of the slide. The cart went with the road.
LISTEN_TO: Cool air breathing out of the hill.
Water dripping, a long way in.
The hill breathes out, and in again, through it.

overrides.OPEN: It's open. A hole doesn't have much else to offer.
